title: Masterpieces
author: Mastermind
description: Masterpieces consists of six episodes, each dedicated to a conversation with prominent figures from the film and TV industries. The interviews trace the conceptualization, production, release and reception of a film or show. They recount the moment inspiration struck, the setbacks, the breakthroughs, and the moment everything fell into place, while also asking each guest to reflect on the lasting legacy of their artistic works. Presented in collaboration with Cartier, this podcast series is a natural extension of the Maison’s longstanding commitment to the magic and craft of cinema.
